QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following compounds has highest boiling point?

Solution.S:
Straight-chain alkanes have a larger surface area compared to branched isomers. This leads to stronger intermolecular van der Waals forces, resulting in higher boiling points.

Among the given options, n-hexane is the straight-chain isomer, so it has the highest boiling point.

Thus, the correct option is A.
